      Project

      A place

      Delete this map?

      Reset the region map?

      Everything goes back: places, terrain and the grid. The party is taken off the map, the fog closes and its travels are cleared. Other maps keep their own places and portals.

      Clear the region map?

      Keep it: it stays in Maps (open it again any time). Delete it: it is gone, unless you exported it.

      Make a region

      Mythastria draws a region from your preferences: terrain, rivers, settlements joined by roads, and sites for adventures (dungeons, caves, ruins, lairs). The same preferences and number give the same region. This replaces the current region: Export it first to keep it.

      Battle

      A standard battle map for this terrain opens in Play live, in its own window. Choose the party there.

      Draw the site

      The local model (LM Studio) designs the rooms from your preferences; Mythastria lays them out on the grid and checks them: walls a whole square thick, doors in walls, every room reachable. It takes a minute or two. The maps open in Play live and are filed under Region sites, then this project and this region.
